alert.title: NetFlow Anomaly Alert with Incomplete Packet Accounting (SYSTEM) [ALT-42838]

evidence.description: NetFlow sensor registered sudden 1.2 GB outbound burst from database server on SRV-EXCHANGE-01
NetFlow collector dropped flow record before remote destination IP was finalized (host: SRV-EXCHANGE-01)

findings.description: NetFlow flow record indicated high volume outbound egress, but collector buffer overflow lost destination host.

output.rationale: Large egress volume warrants concern, but missing destination prevents identifying whether it was scheduled off-site backup or exfiltration.

recommended_actions.action: Examine switch port egress counters and query database server active socket history.

additional_evidence_needed: Database server TCP connection state table

alert.title: Web Server Account Attempting Sudo Enumeration [ALT-47673]

evidence.description: www-data executed 'sudo -l' and attempted to read /etc/sudoers on SRV-PROXY-01
Auditd logged PAM authentication failure for www-data invoking sudo

findings.description: Unprivileged web server service account attempted to enumerate administrative sudo permissions.

output.rationale: Service accounts running web servers should not invoke sudo; strongly suggests web application probe or post-exploitation check.

recommended_actions.action: Review web server access logs for /var/www around execution timestamp to identify web shell or RCE.
